description: This file defines the 'Basket' entity within the application core, representing a shopping basket with methods to add, remove, and modify items, as well as properties to access basket details.

classes.name: Basket
classes.description: Represents a shopping basket, manages basket items, and provides functionality to add, remove, and update items.

methods.name: Basket
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a new basket with the specified buyer ID.

methods.name: AddItem
methods.description: Adds a new item to the basket or updates the quantity if the item already exists.

methods.name: RemoveEmptyItems
methods.description: Removes items from the basket that have a quantity of zero.

methods.name: SetNewBuyerId
methods.description: Updates the buyer ID associated with the basket.
